column5: BepInEx is a decompilation tool for Unity games. The Subnautica pack was created by toebeann.
Nautilus is the core Subnautica modding library that aims to enhance developer productivity by offering common helper utilities as easy to use and robust as possible.
Universal libraries for modders using modules.
Useful tweaks for BepInEx in Subnautica, resolving common issues with BepInEx.
